sections.text: مقدمة

This pump is used to unloading 
 solar fuel oil from cars to large tank of station.

This document outlines the equipment inspection list I3, which 
 must be carried out every one year as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Shady Ghazy and tested by 
 maintenance manager

Eng. Ahmad shanabe and revised by maintenance general 
 manager: eng. Omran Abd El Hamid Shoaib تمت الموافقة عليه من قبل 
 المهندس أحمد صوان رئيس قطاع محطة كهرباء النوبرية و
 revised by MDEPC quality control eng. Abouda El Bana 
 &, and certified by eng. Samir Abd Algalil التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة 
 المدير العام ومنسق MPIS المعتمد من قبل المهندس. 
 Mohamed Nagieb INSP. And quality control head sector
